productInterpretation.productLeadEn: Use Three of Cups to examine completion, plenty, celebration, and shared satisfaction; compare the symbolic perspective with real-world evidence before drawing any conclusion.
productInterpretation.productLeadZhHans: 使用「Three of Cups」检视“完成、丰足、庆祝与共同满足”；在得出任何结论前，把象征视角与现实证据进行比较。
